title: Estimating diagnostic classification models
text: measr, DCMs specified estimated using dcm_specify() dcm_estimate() functions, respectively. ’ll start estimating loglinear cognitive diagnostic model (LCDM). LCDM general DCM subsumes many DCM subtypes (Henson et al., 2009). First, specify model using Q-matrix (qmatrix).
